title: BPS guarded-settlement canary build — Chainlink price guard, controller gate, deployment rehearsal

canaryPolicy.controllerModel: deployed-contract (Safe) via Ownable2Step two-step transfer; rejects zero/dead/self

priceGuard.note: NVDA feed is the multiplier-adjusted Total Return Value/USD; uiMultiplier is NOT re-applied. No official Robinhood Chain sequencer uptime feed is published; mitigated by strict 15-minute dual-feed freshness.

executorGate.controllerTransfer: two-step transferOwnership + acceptOwnership (rejects zero/dead/self via InvalidController)

canaryPreflightTests.canary-preflight.test.ts: core: happy path + 15 fail-closed cases + network tripwire + report
canaryPreflightTests.canary-preflight-cli.test.ts: secret-env abort + missing-RPC + green exit0 + failing exit1 + tripwire

verification.secretScan: no private keys, mnemonics, seed phrases, API keys, or rialto_live_ tokens in changed files
verification.broadcastPathScan: no vm.broadcast / wallet client / signing / sendTransaction path in changed code

rehearsalReceipt.kind: offline local lifecycle rehearsal (Foundry, no fork/RPC, no broadcast)
rehearsalReceipt.method: vm.etch mock code at the pinned official addresses so the pinned config identities are exercised locally
proved: deployPaused deploys the executor paused-by-default and owned by the controller
unpause is blocked by ConfigIncomplete until the full config is set, then succeeds
a fresh dual-feed settlement of 0.001 WETH -> NVDA returns the exact Chainlink oracle-floor NVDA delta
a stale feed reverts and leaves zero router allowance, an unconsumed digest, and an unused nonce
two-step controller transfer (transferOwnership + acceptOwnership) moves ownership

controllerCheck.reason: No controller/Safe address has been provided and no read-only RPC endpoint is configured; eth_getCode on the controller is enforced at run time by the deploy preflight (validate) and the TS canary preflight.
